title: LM2 Compiling a Language Model into Another Model Weights
abstract: arXiv:2611.29577v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deploying a conversational model and a specialist together could avoid maintaining a separate specialist service. We present LM2, which embeds a trained story generator into a larger conversational model. The larger model handles the conversation and invokes the generator for story requests. We constrain the generator arithmetic during training so its calculations can be compiled directly into added model layers. We compare this approach with QwenPU, which executes the stories260K language model on an embedded processor. LM2 requires one host token per generated character, compared with approximately 25,000 for QwenPU. However, its story generator predicts held out text less well, i.e. 1.145 bits per character versus 0.894 for stories260K, where lower is better. translated_title: LM2：将一个语言模型编译进另一个模型的权重中
translated_abstract: 同时部署一个对话模型和一个专用模型可以避免维护一个独立的专用服务。我们提出了LM2，它将一个训练好的故事生成器嵌入到一个更大的对话模型中。较大的模型负责处理对话，并在收到故事生成请求时调用该生成器。我们在训练过程中对生成器的算术运算加以约束，使其计算可以直接编译为新增的模型层。我们将该方法与QwenPU进行了比较，后者是在嵌入式处理器上执行stories260K语言模型。LM2每生成一个字符只需要一个宿主token，而QwenPU大约需要25,000个。然而，其故事生成器对留出文本的预测能力较差，即每字符1.145比特，而stories260K为0.894比特（数值越低越好）。基于Qwen3.5 0.8B的实现占用18.1 GB，并且在测试运行中生成的字符与内部模型的独立整数实现相同。这些结果表明……
tldr: LM2通过在训练时约束生成器的算术运算，将训练好的故事生成模型直接编译进更大对话模型的新增权重层中，使宿主模型每生成一个字符仅需一个token（对比QwenPU方案需约25,000个），代价是文本预测精度略有下降。
en_tdlr: LM2 embeds a trained story generator into a larger conversational model by constraining its arithmetic during training so it can be compiled directly into added model layers, requiring only one host token per generated character versus ~25,000 for QwenPU, at the cost of slightly worse text prediction.
